review.brief_reason: The proposed form only applies exact real-algebra factoring of x2 in three places: (a) 0.693147*x2 + 0.358577787894229*x2/x3 = x2*(0.693147 + 0.358577787894229/x3); (b) 1.149913*x2 + 0.693147*x2/sqrt(...) = x2*(1.149913 + 0.693147/sqrt(...)); (c) 0.958786032514*x2 - 1.149913*x2/sqrt(...) = x2*(0.958786032514 - 1.149913/sqrt(...)). Each is the distributive law, valid for all reals including x2=0, and no new divisions or domain restrictions are introduced (x3!=0 and log/sqrt argument constraints are unchanged). All other subexpressions, constants, and variable-to-column identities are identical. The factored form uses fewer multiplications, so it is simpler.
